recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-12807. Consider FHIR-51935 separately in a run scoped for Resolved - change required R6 terminology clarifications.
issue_request: FHIR-12807 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core terminology issue asking to document how cardinality and value set binding interact, specifically that for required and extensible bindings each repeating CodeableConcept repetition must satisfy the binding rule.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 13380. Git commit 2b8c2d616aaa676498ac6b62c60bb0760db4f570 added the required-binding and extensible-binding max-cardinality paragraphs to source/terminologies.html, with a same-day markup fix afterward.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes terminologies.html as the active Terminology / Using Codes page. FHIR-29968 later rewrote the extensible binding usage notes but preserved the repeated-element rule. FHIR-51935 is a later R6 Resolved - change required issue seeking broader required-binding clarification, including this sentence, but it is not Applied/Published and is outside this default applied/published reconciliation scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current combined branch already says required bindings on max-cardinality > 1 elements apply to all elements and extensible bindings apply to all element repetitions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published extensible-binding rewrite retained the max-cardinality repetition guidance.
